objects.description: [The Gentlemen](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1058) has used double-extortion tactics to sway victims to pay a ransom to include exfiltrating sensitive data, encrypting files, and threatening public release if a payment is not received.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: Sophos_TheGentlemen_Sept2026)(Citation: SoučekESET_Gentlemen_Jun2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)(Citation: BradyUnit42_TheGentlemen_July2026)(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)
